nodes.name: wooden chair with floral cushion
nodes.description: a wooden chair with a light brown frame and a cushion featuring a floral pattern in shades of orange, beige, and brown; the chair has armrests and is positioned on a tiled floor.

nodes.name: black clothing item
nodes.description: a crumpled black piece of clothing, possibly a hoodie or jacket, lying on the left side of the chair's seat.

nodes.name: blue fabric item
nodes.description: a folded blue fabric item, possibly a towel or small blanket, placed on the right side of the chair's seat.

nodes.name: woven wicker table
nodes.description: a rectangular wicker table with a natural brown woven texture, positioned behind the chair and leaning against a wall.

nodes.name: beige sofa or cushioned bench
nodes.description: a beige upholstered sofa or bench with a quilted pattern, located to the left of the chair and partially visible.

nodes.name: tiled floor
nodes.description: a light beige tiled floor with square tiles and visible grout lines, covering the ground surface of the room.

nodes.name: beige wall
nodes.description: a beige wall with a textured, possibly brick-like or panelled surface, visible behind the sofa and wicker table.

nodes.name: white appliance
nodes.description: a white rectangular appliance, likely a portable air conditioner or heater, with a vented side panel, positioned on the floor next to a curtain.

nodes.name: brown curtain
nodes.description: a brown, textured curtain with a shiny or satin-like finish, partially covering the white appliance and hanging from above.

nodes.name: wooden side table
nodes.description: a wooden side table with a glass top, positioned next to the chair; on the table, there is a white remote control and a black object, possibly a phone or charger.

nodes.name: bicycle wheel and basket
nodes.description: a bicycle wheel with a black tire and a wire basket attached to the front, positioned on the floor near the chair and partially under the wooden frame of the chair.

nodes.name: power strip with cables
nodes.description: a white power strip with multiple black cables plugged into it, located on the floor near the chair and the bicycle wheel, with a green indicator light on.

nodes.name: beige patterned curtain
nodes.description: a beige curtain with a subtle floral or striped pattern, hanging in front of the scene and partially obscuring the view of the floor and bicycle wheel.
